$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：巨門獨坐辰戌，《深造講義》p.136。

basis.quote: 须分别其为激发、抑或为遭忌

rules.text: 你的巨門在辰化祿，是天羅地網中的奇格，不在不利之列。
rules.en: Your Ju Men sits in Chen transformed by Lu, a special pattern within the 'heavenly net', not among the unfavourable cases.
rules.edit: 辛年巨門化祿、癸年巨門化權，以四化代年干。

source.quote: 为[奇格]之外，其余的巨门皆为不利

rules.text: 你的巨門在戌吉化，是天羅地網中的奇格，不在不利之列。
rules.en: Your Ju Men sits in Xu with a favourable transformation, a special pattern within the 'heavenly net', not among the unfavourable cases.
rules.edit: 辛年巨門化祿、癸年巨門化權，以四化代年干。

source.quote: 为[奇格]之外，其余的巨门皆为不利

rules.text: 會照的｛魁鉞｝，能減輕你遭忌的性質。
rules.en: With ｛Kui or Yue｝ meeting your chart, the tendency to draw envy and suspicion is lighter.

source.quote: 可以将遭忌的性质减轻

rules.text: 同宮的｛擎羊或火星｝，反而為你產生激發力。
rules.en: With ｛Qing Yang or Huo Xing｝ in your palace, you are actually spurred on.

source.quote: 煞曜唯擎羊、火星可以产生激发力

rules.text: 你的巨門與陀羅同宮，是非困擾頻繁。
rules.en: Your Ju Men shares the palace with Tuo Luo, bringing frequent disputes and vexation.

source.quote: 陀罗同度则不宜，主是非困挠频仍

rules.text: 武曲破軍所在的運，只要見吉化，對你都是好運；只怕武曲化忌。
rules.en: The phase through Wu Qu–Po Jun is good for you whenever it meets helpful transformations; only Wu Qu in Obstruction spoils it.

source.quote: 无论何种性质的巨门均喜经行

rules.text: 天府所在的運，只要見祿或吉化，就是你的好運。
rules.en: The phase through Tian Fu is a good one for you whenever it meets Lu Cun or a helpful transformation.

rules.text: 受激發的你，行到天梁所在的運，那十年必先吃盡苦頭，然後發越。
rules.en: Driven by pressure, the decade through Tian Liang first puts you through real hardship, and then you rise.

source.quote: 天梁宫垣即为激发性的运限

rules.text: 阻力偏多的你，行到廉貞七殺所在的運，若吉化吉星齊集，就是改變處境的機會，一定要把握。
rules.en: With obstacles running high, the phase through Lian Zhen–Qi Sha, when helpful stars gather, is your chance to change your circumstances; seize it.

source.quote: 即为遭忌的巨门改变客观环境的机遇
